models.description: Cloud Gemini model names (verified against firebase.google.com/docs/ai-logic/models on 2026-11-19; both are 'billing not required' on the Gemini Developer API).

cloud_model_fast.description: Cloud model for short/interactive work (diagnosis fallback, report, triage fallback). 2026-11-21: 3.8-flash returning 500 high demand; using 3.5-flash-lite.

cloud_model_compile.description: Cloud model for compiling manual PDFs into fix packs. 2026-11-21: hydrogen hit free-tier quota (429); 3.8-flash timing out (503); using 3.5-flash-lite (healthy).

routing.description: Per-feature routing. Values = AI Logic InferenceMode strings: prefer_on_device | only_on_device | prefer_in_cloud | only_in_cloud. iOS: prefer_on_device = HybridModel(system, cloud); prefer_in_cloud = HybridModel(cloud, system).

route_compile.description: Web: manual PDF -> fix pack. PDF input is cloud-only.

route_triage.description: Web: customer photo pre-triage (text + image, Gemini Nano in Chrome).

route_job_summary.description: Web: short job summary for the dispatcher.

route_ledger_insights.description: Web (optional): insights paragraph over aggregate ledger metadata.

route_nameplate.description: iOS: disambiguate nameplate fields after Vision OCR.

route_diagnosis.description: iOS: map the tech's observation to the next step (structured output).

route_report.description: iOS: customer report; cloud first for long-form quality, on-device when offline.

auto_upgrade_reports.description: iOS: when back online, rewrite an on-device draft report in the cloud automatically (otherwise on tap).

prompts.description: Prompt versions. Prompt text lives in shared/prompts/*.md; bump a version when its file changes.

ondevice_max_tokens.description: Budget for one on-device request (iOS hard cap 4096; Chrome multimodal 9216).

fixpack_min_version.description: Oldest fix-pack schema version clients accept.

diagnosis_confidence_threshold.description: Below this model confidence, the app asks a clarifying tap-choice question.
